selection.text:
InferSent  instead pre-trains the model in a manner of supervised learning.

As reported , the final pre-trained model is able to achieve 97%-98% accuracy on the NSP task.

Note that these in-adjacent sentences will introduce much more training noise to the model.

The method is evaluated on the BERTbase model, which has 12 layers, 12 self-attention heads with a hidden size of 768.

To accelerate the training speed, two-phase training  is adopted.

The numbers of training steps of two phases are 50K and 40K for the BERTBase model.

The label distribution is 1:1:1.

The predictions were obtained by evaluating the training checkpoint with the best validation performance.

Besides NLI, our model also performs better than BERTBase in the STS task.

The improvements suggest that the PSP task encourages the model to learn more detailed semantics in the pre-training, which improves the model on the downstream learning tasks.

The model computes for a concatenation a scalar as the score, which is then used in a softmax layer for the final prediction.

For Chinese NLP tasks, we pre-train the model using Chinese corpus.
